title: US Weighs Public Disclosure of Chinese AI Use by Firms
summary: The Trump administration is reportedly considering requiring U.S. companies to publicly disclose their use of Chinese AI models, with the Treasury Department and White House Office of Science and Technology Policy having discussed the idea. Under the proposal, firms such as Airbnb—which uses Alibaba&\#x27;s Qwen model for customer service—would have to post disclosures on their websites. The reported aim is to discourage reliance on cheaper Chinese open-weight models through public naming rather than impose new restrictions; it is not yet an official policy, and it remains unclear whether the proposal has internal support or will advance to formal legislation.
